thread:
mike: Heads-up from today's ops triage: several models passed our usual smoke + bench but broke on a subset of GPU ABI/kernel combos in staging. We need a new lightweight ABI-compat check in onboarding.

rachel: yep. root cause looked like kernel behavior differences (fused softmax vs separate ops) and subtle reorderings. Hard to catch with only token-level BLEU.

john_s: proposal: add an "abi-prober" after bench that runs deterministic replay of KV-cache for short contexts across a small matrix of kernels/ABIs (e.g., cuBLAS-fused, custom fused-attn, indirect-fft path). Compare token-id prefixes and key statistics (logit-shift histogram).

bench-bot: I can add the job. Plan: N=32 short contexts, deterministic replay (no sampling) seedless, capture token-id seq, logits rounded to 3 decimals, and a small summary: prefix-preserve %, mean logit-delta. Fail if prefix-preserve < 95% OR mean logit-delta > 0.5.

irene: keep it nonblocking by default. If failure happens only on an exotic ABI, mark model as "abi-limited" and block auto-routing to that runtime. Only block full ingest for universal ABI mismatches.

mike: agree. We should avoid slowing onboarding. Make ABI-prober run in parallel and bound to a short timeout (90s). Cache converted kernels/binaries between runs.

infra_bot: note: converter infra can reuse cached kernel artifacts. Also recommend adding exporter stamps so we track which exporter/version produced the artifact.

rachel: dev note: serializer for diffs should canonicalize unicode, normalize quotes, and include token-id sequences plus a tiny human-friendly decode for the mismatched prompts. Helps triage.

john_s: we also need to surface an "ABI impact matrix" in the model page showing which runtime/ABI combos passed/failed. UX should let teams request a manual in-depth repro run.

bench-bot: implementation detail: will produce an artifact with per-ABI metrics and top-5 failing contexts. Will redact logs but attach a small converter stdout snippet for exporters. Estimated overhead: ~1.5min if containers warm, can be parallelized across ABIs.

irene: policy: if only quantized ABIs fail, set flag "no-auto-quant" and create remediation ticket with suggested exporter params. If fused vs unfused FP32 variants disagree, block until infra accepts a manual override.

mike: add a canary: if model is marked "abi-limited" but team requests to enable a specific ABI, allow 0.2% traffic to that ABI for 48h with verbose telemetry. Auto rollback on prefix-loss or error spike.

rachel: long-term: move toward a canonical kernel-contract spec so exporters can validate at build-time. Short-term: abi-prober + UX matrix + ticket flow.

john_s: I'll sketch the RFC follow-up: stage name "abi-prober", serializer spec, thresholds, "abi-limited" semantics, cache policy, and canary runbook. Posting draft in #eng-ml for review.

bench-bot: tagging: @john_s for thresholds, @infra_bot for exporter stamps, @irene for policy. Will start a prototype job and push a PR to the bench repo.

mike: thanks folks. quick action items: john_s write RFC patch, bench-bot prototype, infra_bot add exporter metadata, irene draft policy text. Posting summary to #eng-ml shortly. :thumbsup:
